_required: model / baseUrl / apiKey are the app's three required fields (ADR-0045). A subagent block missing any of them is rejected on startup (src/config.ts validateSettings). The key is provided via stdin and written at 0600 with a backup; its value is never echoed.
_baseUrl: Vendor Anthropic-compatible base URL, WITHOUT /v1 and WITHOUT /messages — the app appends /v1/messages itself (src/subagent/llm-adapter.ts). Anthropic native: https://api.anthropic.com. Chinese gateways: use the gateway's ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic, https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic).
_fallbackModel: Optional overload-degradation model (subagent.fallbackModel, types.ts:222). Empty string = unset.
_optionalNote: Optional fields are NOT written by onboard.mjs — the app applies these defaults and clamps out-of-range values itself (src/config.ts applySubagentDefaults). To override one, edit the subagent block in config.json directly. Keeping a single default source prevents drift.
